limits: Neither the modified rebuild nor the portable replay is byte-identical to the shipped wheel; the shipped bytes keep their existing native and browser qualification.
The modified rebuild used the recorded historical environment of the shipped build, not a newly pinned toolchain.
The replacement run used rebuilt manifest and assets.ts declarations in an isolated qualification copy; the product still pins only the shipped wheel.
The Root build, stage, smoke and qualification receipts are retained outside the product; this record carries their SHA-256 values only.
No legal clearance, IML licensing, whole-source correspondence or other component closure is implied.
